title: 第19章 巨额赌注第20章 叠浪斩的威力
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
第十九章巨额赌注
这时候，场上姜明轩和姜婷宜的比武开始了。
两人一上来，便爆发出引气境九重的实力，进入激烈的交战。
姜明轩使用的是一门黄级低阶的拳法，而姜婷宜则使用一门黄级低阶的指法。
双方前十招是不分高下，但在十招之后，渐渐分出高低。
双方在修为方面旗鼓相当，但姜婷宜凭借在武技方面更加高明的火候，逐渐在场面上占据了上风。
徐茵在场外看着，高悬的心终于慢慢放了下来。只要姜婷宜能够赢姜明轩，接下来她可以想办法让姜明豪和苏尘不要进行第二场比武。
但，就在徐茵暗自松了口气的时候，场上局势却突然发生了意想不到的变化。
只见本来快要落败的姜明轩，在架开姜婷宜的一招攻击之后，趁势退到场地边缘，随后“铿”的一声，突然拔出了腰间的一把长剑！
哗！
场外众人纷纷惊呼起来：“明轩少爷这是要改用剑法武技？”
“快落败了才祭出来，莫非是压箱底的招式？”
徐茵不由得皱眉道：“明轩这么做不合适吧？”
姜山笑了笑：“比武之中换招式有什么不可以的，没人说一场比武必须要一门武技从头用到尾吧？”
的确没人这样说，但双方一开始是拳法对指法，都是徒手武技，你中途却突然拿出一把剑来，难道不是不公平吗？
毕竟谁都知道，对于引气境武者来说，长剑这类兵器的杀伤力是很大的。
徐茵其实很想骂人，但终究忍住了，只是望向场内的神色，不禁带上了一丝担忧。
不过，转念一想，就算姜明轩把拳法武技换成剑法武技，但只要他的剑法武技也是黄级低阶，那么姜婷宜的胜算仍然不低。
因为姜婷宜已经将这门黄级低阶指法武技修炼到炉火纯青的火候，一般的黄级低阶武技是很难与之抗衡。
但，就在徐茵这么想的时候，令人意想不到的事情，再次发生。

姜明轩在拔出长剑之后，紧接着竟然施展出一门黄级中阶的剑法武技！
“青木剑法！”
在姜明轩施展出这门剑法的第一时间，徐茵脸色就变了！
姜山竟然把《青木剑法》这门黄级中阶的剑法武技，传给了姜明轩！
“明轩少爷真厉害，才二十岁的年龄，居然就掌握了黄级中阶的剑法武技！”
“看来这场比武，明轩少爷要反败为胜了。”
“没错，虽然婷宜小姐的指法的确是火候上佳，但黄级中阶武技的优势实在太大了。”
徐茵面色铁青，这姜明轩藏得真是够深，竟然在最后一刻，才把这门压箱底的武技拿了出来。
与此同时，徐茵也终于明白，从一开始自己就被姜山、姜河给算计了，对方派出姜明轩来跟姜婷宜比武，本来就有百分之百的胜算。
至于待会姜明豪和苏尘的那一场，只不过是个添头，顺带羞辱一下她徐茵的娘家人而已。
场中。
姜婷宜苦苦支撑了片刻。
终究还是不敌黄级中阶剑法武技的威力，宣告落败。
“我输了！”
姜婷宜极不情愿的吐出这几个字，一张小脸绷得紧紧的，显得既愤怒又不甘心，说完之后就快步的走出了比武场地。
“娘！”
一回到徐茵身边，姜婷宜就控制不住的大哭起来。
content_en:
Chapter 19 Huge Bet
At this time, the competition between Jiang Mingxuan and Jiang Tingyi began.
As soon as the two came up, they burst out with the strength of the ninth level of the Qi-inducing realm and entered into a fierce battle.
Jiang Mingxuan used a low-level yellow boxing technique, while Jiang Tingyi used a low-level yellow fingering technique.
There was no difference between the two sides in the first ten moves, but after ten moves, they gradually became superior.
The two sides were evenly matched in terms of cultivation, but Jiang Tingyi gradually gained the upper hand in the scene by virtue of her superior martial arts skills.
Xu Yin watched from the sidelines, Gao Xuan's heart finally slowly relaxed. As long as Jiang Tingyi can defeat Jiang Mingxuan, she can find a way to prevent Jiang Minghao and Su Chen from having a second competition.
However, just when Xu Yin secretly breathed a sigh of relief, the situation on the field suddenly changed unexpectedly.
Jiang Mingxuan, who was about to be defeated, took advantage of the situation to retreat to the edge of the field after fending off Jiang Tingyi's attack. Then, with a "clang" sound, he suddenly pulled out a long sword from his waist!
Wow!
Everyone outside the court exclaimed: "Master Mingxuan is going to switch to swordsmanship and martial arts?"
"You only used it when you were about to lose. Could it be that it's a move that puts you at the bottom of the box?"
Xu Yin couldn't help but frown and said, "Isn't it appropriate for Mingxuan to do this?"
Jiang Shan smiled: "There's nothing wrong with changing your moves during a competition. No one said that a competition must use one martial skill from beginning to end, right?"
It is true that no one said this, but the two sides started with boxing versus fingering, both unarmed martial arts, and you suddenly took out a sword in the middle. Isn't it unfair?
After all, everyone knows that for Qi-entraining realm warriors, weapons such as long swords are very lethal.
Xu Yin actually wanted to curse, but she held it back in the end. She just looked at the expression on the court with a hint of worry.
However, when I thought about it, even if Jiang Mingxuan changed his boxing martial arts to swordsmanship, as long as his swordsmanship and martial arts were also low-level yellow, Jiang Tingyi's chances of winning would still be high.
Because Jiang Tingyi has practiced this yellow-level low-level fingering martial arts to a very high level, it is difficult for ordinary yellow-level low-level martial arts to compete with it.
However, just when Xu Yin was thinking this, something unexpected happened again.
After Jiang Mingxuan pulled out his long sword, he immediately displayed a yellow-level intermediate swordsmanship and martial arts!
"Aoki Swordsmanship!"
The moment Jiang Mingxuan displayed this sword technique, Xu Yin's expression changed!
Jiang Shan actually passed the "Aoki Sword Technique", a yellow-level intermediate sword technique, to Jiang Mingxuan!
"Master Mingxuan is so amazing. At only twenty years old, he has mastered the intermediate yellow-level swordsmanship and martial arts!"
"It seems that Master Mingxuan is going to turn defeat into victory in this competition."
"Yes, although Miss Tingyi's fingering skills are indeed excellent, the advantage of Huang-level intermediate martial arts is too great."
Xu Yin's face turned livid. Jiang Mingxuan had hidden it so well that he only took out this hidden martial art at the last moment.
At the same time, Xu Yin finally understood that she had been plotted by Jiang Shan and Jiang He from the beginning. The other party sent Jiang Mingxuan to compete with Jiang Tingyi, who had a 100% chance of winning.
As for the scene between Jiang Minghao and Su Chen later, it was just a cue to humiliate Xu Yin's family.
In the field.
Jiang Tingyi struggled to hold on for a moment.
In the end, he was still defeated by the power of the yellow-level intermediate swordsmanship and martial arts, and was declared defeated.
"I lost!"
Jiang Tingyi reluctantly spat out these words, her little face tensed up, looking angry and unwilling. After speaking, she quickly walked out of the competition venue.
"Mother!"
As soon as she returned to Xu Yin, Jiang Tingyi burst into tears uncontrollably.
